title: eFootball
notes: Console and PC crossplay arrived with version 4.4.0 on April 17, 2025. PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Steam and Xbox on PC players can now meet in Friend Matches and Co-op, and are matched together in eFootball League and Ranking Events, which use one combined ranking.
The mobile version (iOS and Android) is not part of this crossplay. Konami's 2021 plan to bring mobile in was never delivered.
With crossplay switched off you only match players on your own platform and can't enter a Match Room with players from other platforms.
toggle: PlayStation and Steam: Extras > Game Settings > Cross-Platform. Xbox and Xbox on PC: the cross-network play setting in Xbox privacy settings.
progress: Progress carries over only within a family (PS5 and PS4, or Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and Xbox on PC); Konami says data can't move between other platforms or between mobile and console.

sources.title: eFootball is adding crossplay and AI opponents in a major update this week (VGC)

title: Fishing Planet
notes: The developer's support FAQ lists only three crossplay pairs: Steam with Epic Games Store, Android with iOS, and Xbox with the Windows (Microsoft Store) version. Every other combination is blocked.

So Steam players can't fish with Microsoft Store or Xbox players, and PlayStation and Switch players only meet others on the same console family. On PlayStation the game is a PS4 release that also runs on PS5, and online play there needs PS Plus.
Each account stays tied to its platform: progress and purchases can't be moved or shared between accounts.

title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Breakpoint

verdict.summary: Ubisoft confirms Ghost Recon Breakpoint has no crossplay: PC, PlayStation and Xbox players each play only with their own platform.

notes: Ubisoft's help article says crossplay is not available. Crossplay was talked about after launch in 2019 but never added.
On consoles the PS4 and Xbox One versions also run on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S with an enhancement update, and your profile, purchases and inventory carry over to the newer console in the same family.
On PC every copy, including the Steam release from January 2023, needs a Ubisoft account and runs through Ubisoft Connect.

title: Lords of the Fallen (2023)
notes: Steam, Epic, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S players can all play co-op and PvP together. At launch in October 2023 consoles couldn't play with each other and crossplay was briefly switched off; patch 1.1.249 on October 26, 2023 turned on full crossplay across every platform.
Version 2.0 (April 17, 2025) added shared-progression co-op with crossplay through password matchmaking, plus a free Friend's Pass so a friend without the game can join you on any platform.
Crossplay needs everyone on the same game version. In August 2026 a version mismatch broke it for a few days until hotfix 2.5.591 put all platforms back in sync.
toggle: Settings > Multiplayer > Allow Crossplay; everyone in the session needs it on.

title: PlateUp!
notes: Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and the Xbox app / Microsoft Store PC version play together; the Xbox store lists cross-platform and cross-gen co-op.

Since patch 1.3.0 (September 24, 2025) Steam players can turn on PC-crossplay mode in the multiplayer menu to play with other PC versions such as the Windows Store one, inviting friends through Discord. This is PC only and does not reach Xbox consoles; normal Steam play stays Steam only.

No crossplay has been announced for PlayStation (PS4 and PS5) or Switch; patch 1.3.0 moved both onto their own native console networking. Online play needs PS Plus on PlayStation and Game Pass Essential or higher on Xbox.
toggle: Steam: enable PC-crossplay mode in the multiplayer menu.

title: Goat Simulator 3
notes: Steam and Epic players play together; Coffee Stain added this when the game came to Steam on February 15, 2024. The Windows (Microsoft Store) edition is listed with Xbox cross-platform multiplayer, so it plays with Xbox consoles, and Xbox One and Series X|S share sessions.

There's no crossplay between PlayStation and Xbox. On PlayStation and Switch, online co-op is for players on the same platform. Whether PS4 players can join PS5 players, and Switch players join Switch 2 players, isn't confirmed.
Mobile (iOS and Android) supports two players; a widely shared copy of the official FAQ says iOS and Android play together, but we couldn't confirm that from an official page.
Owning it on PS4 or PS5 unlocks the other version, and the same goes for Xbox One and Series X|S.

title: Super Battle Golf

verdict.summary: Super Battle Golf is only on PC (Steam) right now; PS5, Xbox Series X|S and Switch 2 versions with full crossplay are promised for early 2027.

notes: The game launched on Steam (Windows) on February 19, 2026. Console versions were announced for summer 2026, then delayed in August 2026 to early 2027.

The developer says crossplay will cover every platform. An open beta on Steam (October 2026) is moving the game from Steam networking to Epic Online Services to make Steam to console crossplay possible.

title: Gunfire Reborn
notes: Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and the Xbox app / Microsoft Store PC version play co-op together; the Xbox store lists cross-platform co-op on both the console and PC editions. Online play on Xbox consoles needs Game Pass Essential or higher.
The Steam version is not listed with cross-platform play and is not part of that Xbox group, so Steam players only play with other Steam players.
The PS4 and PS5 version (June 2023) supports 4-player online co-op, but no crossplay with other systems has been announced. There's also a separate Gunfire Reborn Mobile app.

title: Strinova

verdict.summary: Strinova is only out on PC so far; the PS5, Xbox Series X|S and mobile versions announced for 2025 haven't launched.

notes: The free-to-play shooter launched on PC on November 21, 2024 through Steam, the Epic Games Store and its own launcher. iDreamSky said PS5, Xbox Series X|S, iOS and Android versions would follow in 2025, but none had released as of October 2026 and no crossplay plans have been announced.

sources.title: Strinova launches November 21 for PC, in 2025 for PS5, Xbox Series, iOS, and Android (Gematsu)

title: Wreckfest
notes: PC crossplay arrived on March 22, 2024: Steam, GOG and Epic players now share the same lobbies. Consoles were not included, so PC, PlayStation, Xbox and Switch each play separately.

Cross-gen play works within each console family. Xbox One and Series X|S players could play together from the June 2021 next-gen launch, and PS4 to PS5 crossplay was added on June 30, 2021. The 24-player lobbies are only on PS5 and Series X|S, so PS4 and Xbox One players can only join 16-player lobbies.
The Switch version (June 2022) has its own online mode for up to 16 players. Wreckfest 2 is a separate game.
